_comment: Real-response semantics measured in docs/02 §B.1 (无效凭证的响应语义) plus the same-status ambiguities of §B.2 / §B.6. expected_verdict is fixed by docs/07 §8.3 (判定表 + 降误报铁律). No credential here is usable: the only key-shaped text is the masked echo the vendor itself returned.

derived_from: 07 §8.3 必须读 body 的 5 组同码歧义

invalid_credential.note: 07 §8.3: xAI / Google answer 400, not 401. Sending no key at all gives 403 (02 §B.1).
07 §8.3 level 1: /api/v1/key is the OpenRouter validation endpoint.
07 §8.3: OpenRouter's /v1/models is public and CANNOT be used to validate.
02 §B.1: public, cannot be used for validation.
07 §8.3: a 401 whose body says '未提供令牌' is a probe construction error -> retry with x-api-key / x-goog-api-key / ?key=

invalid_credential.body_fragment: {"message":"无权进行此操作，access token 无效","success":false}
invalid_credential.note: 07 §8.3 row 6: relay MANAGEMENT api returns 200 with success:false - the status code is unusable, the body decides.

same_status_ambiguity.body_fragment: 用户额度不足, 剩余额度: X
same_status_ambiguity.note: 07 §8.3 铁律: 403 永不直接判失效.
02 §B.6: same 403 as a quota refusal; Content-Type plus UA behaviour differ.

same_status_ambiguity.body_fragment: 您的 IP 不在令牌允许访问的列表中
same_status_ambiguity.note: 02 §B.6: a VALID key can get 403 from IP allow-lists, groups or regions.
07 §8.3: after ruling out the path (trailing slash, /v1beta/models) do NOT judge the key dead.
02 §B.1: not following the redirect is a false positive.
07 §8.3 largest false-positive source: 3.3% - 6.7% of 000s at 60-way concurrency (02 §B.4).

hard_rule: 07 §8.3: 中转站 error.type 由运营者自定义（实测 5 种取值），依赖字面量必然误判. 07 §5.1 P0-6 acceptance: injecting 000 / 403 / 429 must not produce a dead verdict.
